description: For one ANVISA consulta pública: its opening date and contribution window, whether a norm resulted (only links ANVISA itself publishes; an older norm the consultation revises is shown as prior, not as its result), the norm and its date, days elapsed, and the base rate for context (consultation → norm median days and the share of consultations that produce a norm; estimativa). Use for 'did CP 1.234/2023 become a rule, and how long did it take'. Needs the pharmaceutical sector licensed. Deterministic: computed from official datasets, no model in the loop.

consultation.description: The consultation, e.g. 'CP 1.234/2023', 'Consulta Pública nº 1234, de 2023', 'consulta-publica-1234:2023'.
